title: RNA TRIzol Isolation of Datura spp.
author: Eunice Kariñho-Betancourt
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bx4zpqx6
materials: Reagents Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (24:1) 100m l 96 ml Chloroform 4 ml Isoamyl alcohol Saline solution 500 ml 0.8M Sodium Citrate 1.2 M NaCl Distilled water 75% ethanol 100 ml 75 ml of ethanol molecular biology grade (100%) 25 ml of Distilled water )" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Isopropyl alcohol (Isopropanol) molecular biology grade TRIzol reagent (Invitrogen/Thermofisher) DNAsa I RNase free water

The integrity of each sample of RNA was first visualized by electrophoresis in 1.0% agarose stained with Ethidium Bromide (EtBr). The gel was run in TBE 0.5X buffer prepared in water treated with DEPC. Then the quantity and quality of RNA samples were verified by UV absorbance in Nanodrop (Thermo Scientific) and by fluorescence measurements with Qubit 3.0 (Invitrogen) using 2ul of each sample of RNA .

steps.title: Grind tissue to powder
steps.instruction: Grind the tissue into a powder using a mortar and pestle that has been sterilized and kept cold (-80°C for 1 hr) in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Prepare tissue mixture
steps.instruction: Combine ground tissue, TRIzol Reagent, and DNAsa I in a 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube and mix.

substeps.instruction: Add 50-100 mg of ground tissue to the tube

steps.title: Homogenize sample
steps.instruction: Use a Tissuelyser II (QIAGEN) to shake the sample with steel beads.

substeps.instruction: Add two sterilized steel beads to the tube
Repeat the shaking process 2 more times

steps.title: Incubate mixture
steps.instruction: Remove the steel beads and incubate the mixture at room temperature in the Eppendorf tube for 5 min.

steps.title: Separate insoluble matter
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 13,000 rpm for 15 min at 4°C to pellet the insoluble matter.

steps.title: Perform first phase extraction
steps.instruction: Isolate the aqueous phase and treat with isoamyl alcohol.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous phase into a new 1.5 ml tube

steps.title: Centrifuge aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 13,000 rpm for 15 min at 4°C.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Isolate the aqueous phase and add saline solution and isopropanol.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous phase into a new 1.5 ml tube

steps.title: Recover RNA pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at 13,000 rpm for 10 min at 4°C and decant the supernatant, ensuring the pellet is not lost.

steps.title: Wash RNA pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with cooled ethanol and centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 ml 75% cooled ethanol to the pellet
Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 10 min at 4°C

steps.title: Dry pellet
steps.instruction: Open the cap and allow the pellet to air-dry.

steps.title: Resuspend RNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet using RNase-free water and heat.

substeps.instruction: Heat at 55°C to resuspend the pellet carefully

steps.title: Analyze and store RNA
steps.instruction: Quantify the concentration, quality, and integrity of the RNA and store the tube at -80°C.
